Caruana forward selection identified catboost as the single best model; testing whether one model beats the full-pool mean given unstable ranking

decision.justification: The series has a dominant upward trend (strength 0.9999) and strong annual seasonality (strength 1.0). Catboost is the single best model across all 3 validation windows with the lowest overall RMSE. The model pool exhibits very high error correlation (mean 0.892, only 3 independent groups), meaning combining models adds little diversity. The ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.154) and with only 3 validation windows, fitted weights would be high-variance. The leader's margin over the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, confirming that no combination strategy meaningfully outperforms the best single model for this series.
